headline: The h=2 full-trace lemma is FALSE; the correct n=5 statement is a facet dichotomy.
star_normal_form: every full-trace packet is St(H,Q) = 1_{HuQ} + sum_{i in L\Q} 1_{Hui} - (m-|Q|) 1_H = 1_N; type depends only on (|H|,|Q|); always facet-defining (verified n<=6)

non_catalogued: -1*de +1*abd +1*abe +2*cde = 2*1_N  (split, h=2, minimal but decomposable by E={d})

rows_1_to_8.reason: spoke necessity (Lemma C'); r=0 forces every positive set inside E, so u=0 and (PB) gives s<=0

row_9.reason: phase theorem only: it is the star with (h,q)=(3,1), needing (m,h)=(2,3); m_min(3)=3
row_9.note: legitimate packet shape, first realizable at n>=6

row_12.reason: spoke necessity (Lemma C'): no positive set of size 2 containing its singleton exceptional set

row_15.reason: h=1 star normal form (b=1 and unit coefficients); row 15 has b=2

new_lemmas.crossing_budget: S1,S2 phi-tight in an exact singleton-normalized game => s_phi(S1 n S2) <= phi(N\(S1 u S2)); specializations give uncrossing and the paper3 singleton-witness trick
new_lemmas.zeroing_obstruction: loads c_k<=1 for k!=j on phi-tight sets => sum_k c_k phi_k <= phi(N); this is the Farkas dual of min_Core x_j = 0 and refines lem:overload
new_lemmas.spoke_necessity: every normal certificate has some u_i>0, i.e. a positive spoke H u {i}; hence b>0

facet_dichotomy.full_trace_implies_facet: no exception in any case tested (n=5 h=1,2; n=6 h=1,2,3,4)
facet_dichotomy.split_implies_non_facet: true exactly for h<=2 (n=5 (3,2): 6/6 decomposable; n=6 (4,2): 13/13); FAILS at h>=3 (n=6 (3,3): rows 7,24,51,52,53 are split facets; (2,4): rows 4,8,9,14)

search_scope.method: core polytopes C={x>=0, x(N)=phi(N), x(T)>=phi(T), T in F}; leximin, slack and singleton-normalization are all linear conditions on (F, stratification, phi)
search_scope.complete_case: one poor stratum + one rich stratum: |F|<=n+2=7 is provably exhaustive; 101584 families per orbit
not_covered: phi_min = 0 inside a multi-stratum poorer side

open: human proof that the other five split orbits are impossible (mechanism identified: Lemma B with lambda = 1_S + 1_{T2}, S full-trace tight, |S|+|T2|>=n)
proof of split => non-facet for h<=2

corrections_to_briefing.m3_no_split_packets: FALSE. Exact n=5 witness in counterexample_to_h2_full_trace_lemma; both proper traces tight (abd, abe), split packet delta=1.
corrections_to_briefing.delta_sum_route: cannot work alone: conehunt_n5.json shows slack + the full strict-cover condition of Lemma 1 are jointly satisfiable for all 36 split configurations at m=3; only singleton normalization (Lemma B) ever fails.
corrections_to_briefing.one_sided_110_cases: correct and immediate: a split vertex of P_H needs BOTH singleton traces.
corrections_to_briefing.C3_singleton_in_H_never_tight: correct, used throughout; Lemma C' is strictly stronger (kills rows 1-8 and 12, survives mixtures).
corrections_to_briefing.mixture_two_lifts_same_trace: YES, possible; it is exactly how row 15 (three lifts of the trace H at h=1, weights 1/3) and row 9's level-A certificate arise. A mixture can never create a spoke that the system lacks -- that is Lemma C'.

m_indexed_h2_theorem.statement: For m <= 4 and h = 2, every SPLIT packet system is minimal-but-decomposable; hence every facet-defining packet at an h=2 boundary with m <= 4 is a full-trace star.
m_indexed_h2_theorem.status: PROVED by exhaustive enumeration of abstract (P)-shapes (no game geometry): n=5 (3,2) 42 packets/6 split types, n=6 (4,2) 216 packets/13 split types; all decomposable.
m_indexed_h2_theorem.diagnostic_asked_by_lead: No catalogued row with a doubleton exceptional set has split-(P) shape: n=5 rows with |E|=2 are 1,10,13 (10,13 full-trace, 1 has no spoke); n=6 rows with |E|=2 are 1,25,28,29,33,34,39 (28,33,39 full-trace, none split).
m_indexed_h2_theorem.fails_at: m=5 (n=7): team lead's witness is a split (P)-shape that is indecomposable; sel/m5.py quantifies.
m_indexed_h2_theorem.consequence: The n=5 selection theorem holds in its FACET form only: 'm=3 => full-trace' is false, 'm=3 => every facet is full-trace' is true.

h3_m3_breakdown_n6.note: same finite check answers the h=3 question combinatorially
h3_m3_breakdown_n6.conclusion: 'only {H} and the 2-cover carry facets at h=3' is a THEOREM by finite enumeration, same mechanism as the m<=4 h=2 result; the stronger claim that the singleton partition is never selected at all remains game geometry and should be stress-tested (the analogous h=2 m=3 claim was a sampling artifact)

star_facet_proposition.statement: St(H,Q) is a minimal semi-balanced system with exceptional set H and is indecomposable, for every H with 1<=|H|<=n-2 and every Q with empty != Q subsetneq L; type depends only on (h,q); binom(n-1,2) star types on n players.
star_facet_proposition.status: PROVED (report.txt section 3b); audited by sbcheck.classify on all 34 (h,q) pairs for n=4,5,6,7 (sel/starproof.json)
star_facet_proposition.proof_shape: three incidence facts (H in every set; Q only in HuQ; i in L\Q only in Hu{i}) turn minimality and any decomposition into three load equations; eps is constant on H, and each of the branches EnH=empty, Q subset E, QnE=empty forces E in {empty, N, H, HuQ, Hu{i}}, all excluded
